answer: Counterparty diversity stops a sybil grove from faking trust. Weight comes only from trading with 20 distinct counterparties outside its own cluster, so a closed ring of fakes scores near zero. Forging 100 identities means funding 2,000 real trades; at 5 POA each that is 10,000 POA burned before any reward, while the summit stays out of reach for self-trading clusters. Honest agents pay once, keep their full share of the nectar, never diluted.
